| Moderate - for example, sheltered from heavy and wind driven rain and against freezing, whilst saturated with water; buried concrete in soil and concrete continuously under water. | 250 | 0.6 | 290 | 0.55 |
A. Cement shall be ordinary Portland cement conforming to IS 269 for all purpose unless specified differently.
The PH value of water shall not be less than 6 and more than 9.
Chlorides (as C1)  | 2000 mg/l for plain concrete work and 1000 mg/l for reinforced concrete work
The mixer shall be run for a minimum period of 2 minutes after all materials are loaded in full quantity.
Concrete shall be placed in position within 30 minutes from the time it is produced.
Concrete shall be thoroughly compacted, as depositing shall proceed by means of suitable vibrators.
The slump shall be 25 mm to 35 mm depending upon the location and type of Work.
Starting 24 hours after placement of the concrete, the surface shall be cured by flooding with water or covering with damp Hessian cloth for a period of 7 days to keep it moist.
Exposure condition determined outside the document: Moderate
Concrete type determined outside the document: Reinforced Concrete
